knowledge:
- key_parameters: method=Specifies the alignment method in alignToRefs() (e.g., "ClustalW", "ClustalOmega", "Muscle") ;; trimToRef=Logical (default TRUE) in alignToRefs() to crop the alignment to the non-gap span of a chosen prototype ;; refName=Character specifying the anchor reference sequence name (default "JN855971.1_A107") ;; model=Specifies the distance model (e.g., "IUPAC") in assignTypes(), pairwiseDistances(), and overallMeanDistance() ;; deleteGapsGlobally=Logical (default FALSE) in assignTypes() and pairwiseDistances() to perform global gap deletion ;; threshold=Numeric (default 0.105) for genotype assignment distance threshold in assignTypes() ;; show_only_highlighted=Logical (default TRUE) in plotAA() to focus on chosen rows while keeping mismatch context
- alternatives: External alignment tools (e.g., MAFFT, MUSCLE) can be used by exporting references with getPrototypeSeqs() and importing the curated alignment with Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(), which is preferred when users want to manually curate alignments or use external command-line tools.
- when_to_use: Use this package when genotyping rhinovirus sequences (specifically VP4/2 genomic region) and performing downstream distance, phylogenetic, and SNP/amino acid visualization analyses.
- pitfalls: assignTypes() will error if prototype sequences are not present in the input alignment ;; deleteGapsGlobally = TRUE or deleteMissingDataSites() performs global gap deletion which modifies the alignment by dropping any column with a gap in any sequence, potentially distorting distances ;; SNPeek() uses the sequence at the bottom of the alignment as the reference, so users must move their desired reference sequence to the bottom before importing ;; SNP/AA plots may be truncated if the plotting device height is too small; increase device height or use highlight options.

workflows.name: rhinovirus_genotyping_external_alignment
workflows.intent: Genotype rhinovirus sequences by exporting prototype references, aligning them externally, importing the curated alignment, and performing downstream distance and visualization analyses.
input: input_aln.fasta (curated alignment of user sequences and prototype references)
workflows.stages: 1. Export prototype sequences using getPrototypeSeqs() ;; 2. Import the externally aligned and curated FASTA file using Biostrings::readDNAStringSet() ;; 3. Assign genotypes using assignTypes() ;; 4. Plot genotype frequencies using plotFrequency() ;; 5. Compute pairwise distances using pairwiseDistances() ;; 6. Compute overall mean distance using overallMeanDistance() ;; 7. Plot distance heatmap using plotDistances() and tree using plotTree() ;; 8. Visualize SNPs using SNPeek()
workflows.code:
getPrototypeSeqs("~/Desktop")

aln_curated <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(
  system.file("extdata", "input_aln.fasta", package = "rhinotypeR")
)

res <- assignTypes(aln_curated, model = "IUPAC", deleteGapsGlobally = FALSE, threshold = 0.105)
head(res)

plotFrequency(res)

d <- pairwiseDistances(
  fastaData = rhinovirusVP4,
  model = "IUPAC",
  deleteGapsGlobally = FALSE   # set TRUE to apply global deletion inside the function
)

overallMeanDistance(rhinovirusVP4, model = "IUPAC")

plotDistances(d)  

sampled_distances <- d[1:30, 1:30]
plotTree(sampled_distances, hang = -1, cex = 0.6, 
         main = "A simple tree", xlab = "", ylab = "Genetic distance")

SNPeek(rhinovirusVP4)

workflows.name: rhinovirus_genotyping_internal_alignment
workflows.intent: Genotype rhinovirus sequences by aligning them directly in R with packaged prototype references, followed by downstream distance and visualization analyses.
workflows.stages: 1. Align user sequences and packaged prototypes in R using alignToRefs() ;; 2. Assign genotypes using assignTypes() ;; 3. Plot genotype frequencies using plotFrequency() ;; 4. Translate DNA sequences and visualize amino acid alignments using Biostrings::translate(), msa::msa(), and plotAA()
workflows.code:
aln <- alignToRefs(
  seqData   = rhinovirusVP4,
  method    = "ClustalW",           # or "ClustalOmega", "Muscle"
  trimToRef = TRUE,                 # crop to reference non-gap span
  refName   = "JN855971.1_A107"     # default anchor; change if desired
)

aln

res <- assignTypes(aln, model = "IUPAC", deleteGapsGlobally = FALSE, threshold = 0.105)
head(res)

plotFrequency(res)

aln_no_gaps <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(
  gsub("-", "", as.character(rhinovirusVP4))
)

aa <- Biostrings::translate(aln_no_gaps)
aa_aln <- msa::msa(aa)  # align as plotAA expects equal width
aa_aln <- as(aa_aln, "AAStringSet") # transform to AAStringSet
plotAA(aa_aln)
